{{Quote|Is this man troubling you?|Army hauler pilot to Myri Antilles|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] trooper and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he was piloting a military hauler-speeder on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when he and three fellow troopers responded to what appeared to be an assault involving [[Myri Antilles]] and [[Voort saBinring]], members of the recently reformed [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]]. After landing the vehicle beside the Wraiths' parked [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]], the pilot led his squad toward the pair to intervene while Antilles ran behind him, pretending to seek protection. Moments later, after Antilles signaled saBinring to drop to the ground, the pilot was struck in the chest by a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] bolt fired from [[Trey Courser]]'s [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] as Courser remained hidden inside the Wraith's speeder. The remaining members of the squad were also stunned, allowing the Wraiths to commandeer the military hauler-speeder as part of their [[Army hauler hijack|mission]].<ref name="MK" />
